query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `governance_structures` (
  `id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `ventureId` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `founderVetoRights` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `founderVetoScope` TEXT,
  `founderVetoTriggers` JSON,
  `boardSize` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
  `founderSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  `independentSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `investorSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
  `missionAlignedSeats` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `employeeRepresentation` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `communityRepresentation` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `customerAdvisoryBoard` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionClauseInBylaws` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionClauseText` TEXT,
  `antiDilutionProtections` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `changeOfControlProtections` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  `missionDriftProtocol` TEXT,
  `governanceComplianceScore` INT,
  `lastAuditAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `createdAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
